rationale: Posthoc R1+R2: observed CDCL HARD on odd sides 21,25,29,37 (1 mod 4) and often FAST on 19,23,39 (3 mod 4). This is a hypothesis, NOT established mathematical law. R2 size-only n=500 rule failed (21 timeout and 39 regret). R3 pre-registers falsification on previously untouched sizes and separate original SHA.

training_only.role: negative boundary observations and new posthoc parity-class hypothesis

pre_solve_selector.preconditions: No trial outcome, no planted SAT model, no solver run, no timing observation may be used before decision. Derive topology from input CNF only.
rules: otherwise build exact complete parity blocks from EVERY original CNF clause, with bounded 140000 literal scanning and original source unchanged; if not exact: original CNF CryptoMiniSat
validate parity-equation supports are exactly the 2D grid five-neighbor toggle topology for side=sqrt(n), no non-grid shape inference
on exact grid with odd side%4==1 choose JANUS standalone GF2, including recognition and original model replay
on exact grid with odd side%4==3 choose original CNF CaDiCaL195
on otherwise valid exact XOR grid choose CryptoMiniSat native-XOR

source_generator: Same pinned R1 row-major full parity CNF generator, via explicit 5-neighbor grid toggle supports and random.Random(seed).getrandbits(1); compare against archived R1 originals for compatibility before any measurement.
negative_controls: Drop one original clause from new R3 grid33 and grid41: if exact proof fails, selector MUST choose unmodified original CryptoMiniSat
Alter just one support in a complete cover: topology check MUST decline grid-specific mod4 shortcut and choose unmodified original CryptoMiniSat
Known R1 UNSAT GF2 witness must replay same-admin only, never counted as new R3 performance or external independent proof
Verify R1+R2 training report git blobs before R3 source generation

benchmark.time_measurement: Full parent-measured cold subprocess wall: imports/startup + original CNF generation/verification + pre-solve certification/selection + engine solve + exact SAT model replay on original CNF + serialization.

frozen_gates.per_source_per_host: All three selector repetitions must be SAT_VERIFIED; compare median against fastest successfully SAT_VERIFIED 3/3 of EXTERNAL competing baselines only; direct JANUS GF2 ablation is NOT in denominator. A baseline timeout is right-censored and cannot be assigned a finite solve time or fake gain.
frozen_gates.narrow_hypothesis: At least TWO DISTINCT NEW mod4==1 SIDE SIZES (33 AND 41) show selector >=1.20x against fastest successfully verified external competitor on BOTH hosts, and every other new source is within 5% regret of best verified external competitor on BOTH hosts, with every original SAT answer checked against all original CNF clauses.
frozen_gates.strong_all_control_gate: Every external baseline must complete all 3/3 trials on every source; if any censored, strict all-control gate must remain NOT PASSED even when partial comparison shows gain.
frozen_gates.abstention_gate: Any incomplete parity block, non-Lightsout topology or resource cap => no GF2 selection, retain unchanged original CNF.
frozen_gates.conclusion_ceiling: Even if narrow gate passed, no claim of general 3-SAT acceleration, P=NP, Stage5 general SAT gate or external independently sealed proof.
